title: Detailed teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left ear outer -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='12' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Left ear inner -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='7' fill='#E8A87C'/>
  <!-- Right ear outer -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='12' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Right ear inner -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='7' fill='#E8A87C'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#A0692C'/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#E8B07A'/>

  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='68' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 27 68)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='68' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 73 68)'/>

  <!-- Left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='92' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='92' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Left foot pad -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='93' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#E8A87C'/>
  <!-- Right foot pad -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='93' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#E8A87C'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='23' fill='#A0692C'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#E8B07A'/>

  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='4' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='4' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <!-- Nose highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='45' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 49 Q46 55 43 53' stroke='#6B4226' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q54 55 57 53' stroke='#6B4226' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush left -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush right -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='48' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,62 42,58 42,66' fill='#E85A5A'/>
  <polygon points='50,62 58,58 58,66' fill='#E85A5A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#C93A3A'/>

  <!-- Stitching on belly -->
  <path d='M42 73 Q50 70 58 73' stroke='#C98A50' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <path d='M42 83 Q50 80 58 83' stroke='#C98A50' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
</svg>
